day_shape: 66 items: IDF publishes first post-Oct 7 military probes (closing WCK inquiry, opening Hind Rajab criminal case) alongside strikes killing Hamas commanders in Nuseirat and Gaza City, FT reports Iran weighing attacks on European military targets, UAE said to suspend all trade with Iran, and heavy Qalibaf-in-Baghdad regime messaging; nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes and tunnel operations
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck two Hamas commanders in Nuseirat and Tuffah, with Palestinian media reporting nine killed at a Gaza City police station and further casualties from a central Gaza drone strike. The military also announced two Hamas tunnels totalling over 2km had been sealed with concrete in central and southern Gaza.

threads.label: IDF publishes first post-Oct 7 probes
threads.summary: The IDF Military Advocate-General published findings from the first of over 150 probes launched since the October 7 massacre, closing the investigation into the World Central Kitchen deaths. A criminal inquiry into the killing of Hind Rajab remains open.

threads.label: Iran diplomatic and coercive signals
threads.summary: The Financial Times reported Iran has considered attacking military targets in Europe if Trump escalates the war, while the Jerusalem Post reported the UAE suspended all trade and financial transactions with Iran after attacks on UAE-owned tankers. Former president Khatami backed the Islamabad MoU signed by Pezeshkian and Trump, warning against losing the opportunity.

threads.label: Qalibaf in Baghdad, anti-Western messaging
threads.summary: Regime channels covered Speaker Qalibaf's Baghdad visit with Iraqi counterpart Mahmoud al-Mashhadani, quoting him that America causes regional insecurity and Israel will not achieve a Jordan-to-Sea concept. National Security Commission head Azizi said Iranians would not forget French betrayals over tainted blood, INSTEX and snapback.

threads.label: Regime military and Yemen-Saudi blockade claims
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB reported Quds Force commander Qaani saying the 'Zionist regime' faces 'social cancer' and internal collapse, and Pezeshkian reaffirming government support for the armed forces. Regime channels also claimed Yemen's forces had struck eight Saudi oil tankers since the 29 July blockade began, expanding targets to Jizan and Najran.

threads.label: Israeli regional posture: Turkey, Greece, Bennett
threads.summary: Turkey rejected Israeli allegations over a potential Turkish troop deployment at a Syrian airbase which the PMO said would threaten Israel, while IDF Chief Zamir hosted Greek defence chief General Choupis. Former PM Bennett said any Hezbollah attack should trigger direct retaliation against Iran and called for a new 'Unit 8300' influence body.

threads.label: Domestic Iran: rights, economy, judiciary
threads.summary: Iran International reported the Pezeshkian administration formally opposed the foreign-infiltration bill as violating rights and risking brain drain, while the Jerusalem Post reported a new Tehran 'moral security' prosecutor's office for hijab and social media cases. Judiciary reshuffled nine senior officials, and luxury north Tehran property was advertised at $13,228 per square metre.

events.title_en: United States debt will cross 40 trillion dollar mark this week
events.summary_en: United States national debt is expected to cross the 40 trillion dollar mark this week, a figure materialising several months earlier than previous projections. According to the Washington Post, a reduction in government revenues, including due to the cancellation of Donald Trump's trade tariffs, has forced the United States Treasury to borrow more quickly to pay current expenses. The annual cost of servicing this debt will also exceed one trillion dollars this year, a figure roughly equivalent to the Pentagon's budget.
